title: ProblemsReader
description: The Problems query depends only on the `ProblemsReader` interface; the query runner (`answerQuery`) makes it with the definition's `reader`, `problemsReader`, over the data with the checks' run, and hands it to the handler. Today's implementation, `InMemoryProblemsReader`, reads the table the projection builds in memory on each read, so keeping the read model elsewhere is a new implementation and nothing more.
